creator: leadwithzoe
title: Use Claude Cowork to organize a messy desktop/photos: attach the folder, prompt with your organizing scheme (by year/topic), answer its clarifying questions

tools.name: Claude Cowork (desktop app)
tools.detail: Chat / Cowork / Code tabs; attach a folder (Desktop or Documents)

claims: Organizing files that used to take hours now takes a couple of minutes
how_to_steps: Open the Claude desktop app, click Cowork, attach the folder you want organized (Desktop/Documents)
Write a prompt asking it to organize files and photos; give the scheme you want (by year, by topic)
Answer Claude's clarifying questions carefully since they shape the whole system
on_screen_only: Desktop screenshot covered in files; Claude app sidebar with Chat / Cowork / Code, New chat, Projects, Artifacts, Customize; Cowork prompt 'What's on your plate today?'
Handwritten overlay list: 1. connect in cowork, 2. write a prompt, 3. clarify

relevance.why: Consumer file-tidying; Haji already uses Cowork for far more. Nothing for apps or business.

implement_score.why: Trivial; could run once on a Downloads folder, but it is not a workflow improvement.

verify: Cowork moves/renames files on disk; confirm it offers a dry-run plan before executing

gap.what: Below the level of liked content; no new tool or technique.
